rules.reason: Workflow, suite map, classifier and gate changes are merge-policy changes; they always run every suite.

Markdown outside the bundled skills and scripts. check-skill-overrides.mjs checks policy-anchor links in every tracked Markdown file, and test-build-metadata.py reads docs/agents/merge-policy.md, so validate-contracts applies. No Xcode resource, build phase, test.sh input or guide probe input reads these files.
Documentation images. No build input, bundled resource, test or CI suite reads them.

Design evidence and prototypes under docs/. Not bundled or read by native tests or the guide probe. validate-contracts still runs, conservatively, in case the Markdown checks read a file whose name the markdown-docs rule does not match.
Leaf test files that only validate-contracts runs. Nothing bundles, builds, imports or hashes them; the code they test is unmapped and selects every suite.
